title: docs: replace dead external demo and skill links with repo paths
author: yzxcj797
pr_body_excerpt:
Two links point to removed external resources:

1. `apps/ai-dungeon-master/README.md` — the live demo at `codevector-2003.github.io/pollinations/` returns 404 (GitHub Pages deployment removed). Updated to link to the app's source directory in this repo.

2. `apps/openclaw/README.md` — the Pollinations skill documentation at `openclaw/skills/.../isaacgounton/pollinations/SKILL.md` returns 404 (the skill directory no longer exists in that repo). Updated to link to the openclaw app in this repo. The `/skill install` command below is left unchanged — the skill may still be installable from a different source.

gist.headline: Paths Lead Home
gist.blurb: Two README trails were pointing into the fog. They now lead straight back to the apps living here in the garden.
gist.summary: Replaced dead external links in the AI Dungeon Master and OpenClaw app READMEs with direct paths to each app's source directory in this repository.
gist.impact: Readers can now reach the maintained AI Dungeon Master and OpenClaw app sources directly instead of landing on removed GitHub Pages or skill-documentation URLs.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden path represents repaired documentation links: Polli uses a tiny map and signposts to guide visitors toward two nearby app cottages, one with a fantasy dungeon map and one inhabited by a friendly little crab-like OpenClaw mascot. Small code-plants and flowering repo folders make the source paths feel like a welcoming destination.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheeks and light blue wings, wearing a tiny explorer hat and holding a map beside two clear garden signposts labeled in simple pixel text 'AI Dungeon Master' and 'OpenClaw'; one path leads to a cottage with a dungeon map, while a friendly small crab mascot waves from the other beside code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
